start: Owner; the gym took payments this month by cash and UPI

user_sees: Title 'Money' with 'Every rupee that came in'
Tabs 'Collections' and 'Dues'
'Period' chips: 'Today', 'Last 7 days', 'This month' (picked), 'Last month', 'This financial year', 'Custom'
Tiles 'Collected' (with '<n> receipts'), 'Average receipt', 'Largest receipt', 'Cancelled' (with '<n> not counted')
'How it came in' with one bar per method
must_not: 'Collected' differing from the sum of the receipts listed below
Cancelled money inside 'Collected'

user_sees: A line with the period, and any method, 'Taken by' and search in use
Boxes 'Search' ('Receipt no, name, mobile or reference'), 'Method', and 'Taken by' when receipts carry who took them
A tick box 'Show cancelled receipts'
A table 'Date', 'Receipt', 'Member', 'For', 'Method', 'Amount', 'Actions' (cards on a phone)
must_not: A receipt outside the period
The tiles keeping the old total after a filter is picked

user_sees: Only that person's receipts; the tiles and bars follow
must_not: Tiles still showing everyone's money above one person's list

user_sees: A file named with the gym, 'collections' and the two dates is saved
A note 'Exported <n> receipts.'
must_not: Rows in the file that are not on screen
Amounts in the file that do not add up to 'Collected'
Mobile numbers turned into scientific notation in Excel

start: Today (home) screen; the owner taps the 'Today's collection' tile

user_sees: 'Money' opens on 'Collections' with the period 'Today' picked
must_not: 'This month' picked, so the number differs from the tile
Yesterday's late receipts counted as today

start: Collections; the desk entered a payment by mistake (cancelling a receipt)

steps.action: Use the cancel action on that receipt's row
user_sees: A sheet 'Cancel this receipt?' with a box for the reason
must_not: The receipt cancelled on the first tap

steps.action: Type a reason and tap 'Cancel receipt'
user_sees: 'Cancelling…', then the note 'Receipt cancelled. The amount is back in their dues.' (or 'Receipt cancelled.' when nothing goes back)
'Collected' goes down by that amount; 'Cancelled' goes up by it and its count by one; the receipt leaves the list
must_not: The money still in 'Collected'
The member still shown as paid
The receipt deleted with no trace

user_sees: The cancelled receipt is back in the list, marked as cancelled
must_not: Its amount added to the total again

start: Collections with nothing to show or wrong input

steps.action: Pick a period with no payment
user_sees: Tiles at zero
'Nothing collected in this period' under 'How it came in'
'No receipts here' with 'Nothing matches this period and these filters.'
'Download Excel file' greyed
must_not: 'NaN' or a dash in 'Average receipt'
An empty file downloaded

user_sees: The page keeps working, falling back to today for the empty date
must_not: A blank page
A crash while a date is half typed

steps.action: In 'Cancel this receipt?' type one letter as the reason
user_sees: 'Cancel receipt' greyed; on trying, 'Write a short reason, so it is clear later.'
must_not: A receipt cancelled without a reason

steps.action: Search for a name with no receipt
user_sees: 'No receipts here'
must_not: The tiles still showing the whole period's money

user_sees: The receipt hidden; counted under 'Cancelled'
must_not: It counted in 'Collected' again

user_sees: It appears, then hides; the tiles do not move
must_not: The total changing with the tick box

steps.action: Look for a cancel action on the cancelled receipt
user_sees: None
must_not: A receipt cancelled twice, putting the due back twice

user_sees: Cancelled money in its own column, not in the amount column
must_not: A file whose amount column no longer adds up to 'Collected'

start: The gym has an owner and a front desk person

steps.action: Sign in as the front desk and open 'Money'
user_sees: Only the dues list: no 'Collections' tab, no totals
must_not: Collections reachable by typing /money or /money/today

steps.action: As owner, download the Excel file
user_sees: A file with members' names, mobile numbers and what they paid, saved on this device only
must_not: The file sent anywhere by the app
